blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-migration-1 (camelCase rename silently renames every existing field of the public order JSON) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it
R-migration-2 (Existing config files without `default_currency` no longer load) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.evidence:
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct OrderResponse {
    pub order_id: i64,
    pub customer_id: i64,
    pub total_cents: i64,
findings.recommendation: Remove `#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]` so `GET /orders/{id}` keeps emitting `order_id`, `customer_id` and `total_cents` and only adds `currency`. Today a partner integration reading `order_id` from the response gets a missing field (`orderId` is sent instead) on the first deploy, with no BREAKING item in the release note and in breach of the rule in docs/api.md ("a field is never renamed or removed without two releases of deprecation"); docs/api.md also still documents the snake_case names. If camelCase is wanted, ship it as a separate change that emits both names during two releases of deprecation and marks it **BREAKING** in the release note.
findings.title: camelCase rename silently renames every existing field of the public order JSON

findings.evidence:
/// The currency of orders that do not name one (ISO 4217).
pub default_currency: String,
findings.recommendation: Give the field a default (`#[serde(default = "default_currency")]` returning `"EUR"`, the currency of every existing order) so a deployed `config.toml` holding only `database_url` and `listen` keeps loading. As written, `config::load` returns a `missing field default_currency` error and the service fails to start on upgrade, with no release-note item telling operators to add the key. Add a test that loads the old two-key config, or, if the key must stay required, mark it **BREAKING** in the release note with the line to add.
findings.title: Existing config files without `default_currency` no longer load
